Rooms.Name: The Outskirts of the Battlefield
Rooms.Description:
The trees thin out, allowing you to see a huge field, marked with 
the signs of an ancient battlefield. No natural sounds can be heard at
all, except for the constant whining noise of the wind, blowing over 
the field. To the north lies the path out of here, to the south lies 
the history of an ancient battlefield.

Rooms.Name: Monument of the Fallen
Rooms.Description:
Here, a large monument has been erected to honor those who fell
beneath the evil they were fighting. Peace fills you, but at the same
time a cold evil seeps in to you, chilling your bones and flesh.
The monument shows a priest, holding a fallen soldier in his arms,
while giving the last blessing...praying for his soul. The only exit
is to the east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large monument erected to honor those who fell and willing gave up
their life to prevent evil from winning. You wonder if there were any
winners. On a gilded plaque by the bottom of the monument, hundreds of
names have been carved. Gorak Ironfist, Lord Captain Dreilim, Ischii
the sneaky one, Geyrn...So many...so many...

Rooms.Name: The Ancient Battlefield
Rooms.Description:
The ground here is heavily damaged. Magic and catapults come to your
mind. Metal glimmers everywhere, and you wonder how much mother nature
has managed to hide during all this time. As you look around, you see
the field stretch out in all directions.

Rooms.Name: The Ancient Battlefield
Rooms.Description:
Damaged terrain, burned trees...After the war, only destruction
remains. You think, will this ever 'heal', and at once doubt fills you.
The memories will always remain. Around you, the field stretches out.

Rooms.Name: The Ancient Battlefield
Rooms.Description:
A battlefield, with the scars of a long done battle. A very fierce
battle. By judging the damage, the remains, you come to the conclusion
that this battlefield, must have held one of the most vicious battles
in history. These scars will always remain. The field stretches out
around you like a carpet of destruction.

Rooms.Name: The Ancient Battlefield
Rooms.Description:
The savage scars of great fierce battles mark the ground, and the
surrounding area. Metal glimmers everywhere, arrowheads, swordtips...
even some bones can be seen, half buried by time itself. But not even
time will be able to cover it all. The field goes on in all directions.

Rooms.Name: The Ancient Battlefield

even some bones can be seen, half buried by time itself. But not even
time will be able to cover it all. The field goes on in all directions.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Mausoleum
Rooms.Description:
Here, is a pair of huge doors. One of the doors hangs slightly from
one of its hinges. You wonder what tremendous force could have wrecked
theese doors. The mausoleum looks old, very old as it stands among the
shattered remains of a once truly beautiful forrest. Behind you, to
the north, lies the main part of the battlefield, and to the south,
lies the secrets of the temple.

Rooms.Name: North Wing Entrance
Rooms.Description:
Here is a magnificently decorated chamber. The walls are covered
with great illustrations of all kinds of things. Great beings, holy
relics...Although, one common factor can be found. They all tell of the
the fierce northerners, the cold wintery winds of the north, snowy high
mountainpasses. A hall goes to the north, and to the south you see a
huge chamber, glowing with a pale illuminating light. A stairway leads
down into the dark.

Rooms.Name: West Wing Entrance
Rooms.Description:
Here is a magnificently decorated chamber. The walls are covered
with great illustrations of all kinds of things. Great beings, holy
relics...Although, one common factor can be found. Everything concerns
forrests, and lakes. You can't help the feeling of spring washing over
you. You even think you can smell life begin to bloom. To the East a
pale light shines in through a huge archway, and a stairway can be 
found leading downwards.

Rooms.Name: The Altar of Purification
Rooms.Description:
This chamber is huge. Large colored windows in the ceiling let a 
pale light illumine the chamber. A large and incredibly beautiful altar
has been erected in the middle of the room. As you near it, a peace
fills you, making you feel safe and...clean. Huge archways can be found
in every direction.

Rooms.Name: East Wing Entrance
Rooms.Description:
Here is a magnificently decorated chamber. The walls are covered
with great illustrations of all kinds of things. Great beings, holy
relics...Although, one common factor can be found. Everything is about
the autumn, the falling of leaves. The cold setting in. Everything
preparing for the cold of the winter. To the west lies a huge chamber,
and some stairs lead down into the darkness.

Rooms.Name: South Wing Entrance
Rooms.Description:
Here is a magnificently decorated chamber. The walls are covered
with great illustrations of all kinds of things. Great beings, holy
relics...Although, one common factor can be found. Everything tells of
the warmth of the summer, the rising of the sun. Life will be reborn,
everything walks again. To the north, an altar has been erected, also,
some stairs are leading down from here.

Rooms.Name: Zombie Spawning Room
Rooms.Description: No access!

Rooms.Name: Zombie Spawning Room
Rooms.Description: No access!

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Sir Durhne
Rooms.Description:
This is the tomb of Sir Durhne, one of the good forces most 
brilliant swordsmen. The stories tell of him, wielding a shortsword
in each hand, while 'dancing' the blades with his enemies. The tomb
itself, is very plain. No carvings except his name on a small gilded
plaque. The only exit lies to the south.

Rooms.Name: A Ruined Tomb
Rooms.Description:
Chaos fills this room. You see the remains of the tomb spread out
all over the room. Parts lie everywhere, but...who would have done such
a thing? You dig some after the nameplate, and find it well concealed
beneath the rubble. But when you try to read the name, you can't help
but fail. The name's been destroyed by someone. The hall can be found
just to the east of here.

Rooms.Name: A crossing in the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
A large and pretty dark room, with exits in all directions. A large
holy symbol has been placed in the middle of the crossing, glowing with
a faint light. Inscribed on the symbol are the words 'Peace favor those
who fell beneath the shadow'.

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Lady Nemia
Rooms.Description:
A large, heavily marked glass chest lies in the middle of this room.
Within it, you can see a beautiful woman, lying on a bed of large green
leaves. She's dressed in a white robe, with her arms folded over her
chest. There's a silvery plaque on the far side of the chest. On it,
the words 'Lady Nemia, her sacrifice will never be forgotten'. The exit
lies to the west.

Rooms.Name: A Passage in the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
A dark and musty catacomb moving from the north to the south,
binding together the tombs of the fallen. You can see a holy symbol
standing in the crossway both to the north and to the south of here.

Rooms.Name: A Nameless Hero's Grave
Rooms.Description:
A simple tomb, a simple final resting place. You wonder who might
be resting here, but fail to find anything that might reveal that.
No plaque, no sign...Nothing that can tell the story of the fallen
resting in here. There's a crossing to the east.

Rooms.Name: A Crossing in the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
A large and pretty dark room, with exits in all directions. A large
holy symbol has been placed in the middle of the crossing, glowing with
a faint light. Inscribed on the symbol are the words 'Peace favor those
who fell beneath the shadow'.

Exits.Description: The Tomb of Gaffyn the Bold

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Gaffyn the Bold
Rooms.Description:
This chamber, is being dominated by a huge chest of what seems to be
dark black marble stone. It's magnificent. Cut out on one of it's
sides, are the words 'Gaffyn the Bold, The Northerner. His deeds turned
the winds in our favor'. A large crossing can be seen to the west.

Rooms.Name: Shrine of the North
Rooms.Description:
In here a small altar has been placed, surrounded by hundreds of
burning candles, making the shadows dance on the walls. The altar
is small and very simple, seemingly made out of white oak. There's a
stairway going up here, and a long hall can be seen going to the north.

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Ahania, the Berzerker
Rooms.Description:
This is a very grim looking chamber. It resembles a cave, with very
rough walls. You wonder what the meaning is behind this. In the middle
of the room, a tall piedestal has been placed with an urn standing on
top of it. On the piedestal a small plaque with the words 'Ahania,
consumed with fire. Struck down with thunder'. There's a long hallway
just to the east of here.

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Sir Wyneh
Rooms.Description:
In this chamber, a large stone coffin has been placed in the middle
of the floor. The lid lies on the floor right next to it, broken in
two. Inside the coffin, there's nothing. On a small gilded plaque, the
words 'Sir Wyneh, Destroyer of darkness' have been inscribed. To the
south a crossing can be seen.

Rooms.Name: A crossing in the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
A large and pretty dark room, with exits in all directions. A large
holy symbol has been placed in the middle of the crossing, glowing with
a faint light. Inscribed on the symbol are the words 'May the Eternal
Light, guide our fallen to their final rest.'

Exits.Description: The Tomb of Ahania the Berzerker

Rooms.Name: A Nameless Hero's Grave
Rooms.Description:
A simple tomb, a simple final resting place. You wonder who might
be resting here, but fail to find anything that might reveal that.
No plaque, no sign...Nothing that can tell the story of the fallen
resting in here. There's a crossing to the north.

Rooms.Name: A Passage in the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
A dark and musty catacomb moving from the east to the west,
binding together the tombs of the fallen. You can see a holy symbol
standing in the crossway both to the east and to the west of here.

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Lord Konrad
Rooms.Description:
A very well decorated chamber, full of tapestries decorating the
cold stone walls. Small lanterns are dangling from the ceiling,
spreading a soft light all over the room. A heavily decorated coffin
dominates the chamber. On the far wall, a large sign with the words
'Lord Konrad, sacrificed his life and eternal soul for our success.
He will never be forgotten', written upon it. To the south, you see a
crossing, and a large holy symbol glowing faintly.

Rooms.Name: A crossing in the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
A large and pretty dark room, with exits in all directions. A large
holy symbol has been placed in the middle of the crossing, glowing with
a faint light. Inscribed on the symbol are the words 'May the Eternal
Light, guide our fallen to their final rest.'

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Lady Irinah
Rooms.Description:
A chamber completely decorated with velvet cloth. Very soft, and not a
single sound can be heard. You feel very relaxed in here, as if nothing
could trouble you here, but then you notice a skeleton lying in a
corner. A large coffin is leaning against the far wall, glowing with
a soft blue light. On it, the words 'Lady Irinah, She found her peace,
may she never be disturbed' cut into it. To the north the crossing can
be found.

Rooms.Name: Shrine of the West
Rooms.Description:
In here a small altar has been placed, surrounded by hundreds of
burning candles, making the shadows dance on the walls. The altar
is small and very simple, seemingly made out of white oak. There's a
stairway going up here, and a long hall can be seen going to the west.

Rooms.Name: Shrine of the East
Rooms.Description:
In here a small altar has been placed, surrounded by hundreds of
burning candles, making the shadows dance on the walls. The altar
is small and very simple, seemingly made out of white oak. There's a
stairway going up here, and a long hall can be seen going to the east.

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Den'Drelich, the Windrider
Rooms.Description:
A large spacious chamber, but something strikes you odd. There's no
coffin, no final resting place. Other than that, the walls are very
smooth, and they almost glimmer in the faint light from the torches
that line the walls. Then you see something shining along the far wall.
A large metal ring, and then it strikes you. The whole floor is one
big trapdoor. You wonder, WHAT could be down there? To the south, the
crossing can be found.

Rooms.Name: A crossing in the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
A large and pretty dark room, with exits in all directions. A large
holy symbol has been placed in the middle of the crossing, glowing with
a faint light. Inscribed on the symbol are the words 'May the Blessing
of the Creator protect our fallen comrades'

Exits.Description: The Tomb of Den'Drelich, the Windrider

Rooms.Name: A Ruined Tomb
Rooms.Description:
Chaos fills this room. You see the remains of the tomb spread out
all over the room. Parts lie everywhere, but...who would have done such
a thing? You dig some after the nameplate, and find it well concealed
beneath the rubble. But it's only a small part of the name that can be
read. '...rgehn, the Fiery La...', nothing else is readable. The hall
can be found just to the north of here.

Rooms.Name: A Passage in the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
A dark and musty catacomb moving from the east to the west,
binding together the tombs of the fallen. You can see a holy symbol
standing in the crossway both to the east and to the west of here.

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Mistress Silfane
Rooms.Description:
A very bright chamber, with large mirrors placed along the walls.
In the middle of the room, a large mirror has been placed, and within
it, you see the reflection of a beautiful woman. She's...glowing with
magic and strength, and you wonder if she really is dead. Then it
strikes you, you have no reflection in this mirror. Along the frame of
the mirror some words have been carved in, 'Silfane, Mistress of the
mirrors. Her light blessed us, her light blinded the evil'. To the
south lies a crossing.

Rooms.Name: A crossing in the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
A large and pretty dark room, with exits in all directions. A large
holy symbol has been placed in the middle of the crossing, glowing with
a faint light. Inscribed on the symbol are the words 'May the Blessing
of the Creator protect our fallen comrades'

Rooms.Name: A Nameless Hero's Grave
Rooms.Description:
A simple tomb, a simple final resting place. You wonder who might
be resting here, but fail to find anything that might reveal that.
No plaque, no sign...Nothing that can tell the story of the fallen
resting in here. There's a crossing to the north.

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Sir Heilon
Rooms.Description:
In here, the first thing you see, is a large throne with a very old
skeleton sitting upon it. It must have been like this for years and
years. By judging the skeleton, you come to the conclusion that the
'owner' was a very tall, and propably very thin man. On a dusty plaque
behind the throne on the far wall, you see the words 'Final resting
place of Sir Heilon. His blade cut the darkness in two'. To the west a
long hallway continues.

Rooms.Name: Shrine of the South
Rooms.Description:
In here a small altar has been placed, surrounded by hundreds of
burning candles, making the shadows dance on the walls. The altar
is small and very simple, seemingly made out of white oak. There's a
stairway going up here, and a long hall can be seen going to the south.

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Captain Paplaus II
Rooms.Description:
A small chamber, with a small coffin in the middle of the room.
A very simple room, and a very simple coffin. On the coffin a few words
have been cut in. 'Captain paplaus II, although small, his heart was
braver and stronger than most. He defied evil in our darkest hours'.
To the east a crossing can be seen.

Rooms.Name: A crossing in the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
A large and pretty dark room, with exits in all directions. A large
holy symbol has been placed in the middle of the crossing, glowing with
a faint light. Inscribed on the symbol are the words 'May the Light
shelter those who gave their lives for us'.

Exits.Description: The Tomb of Nioshi, the nimble one
The Tomb of Captain Paplaus II

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Nioshi, the nimble one
Rooms.Description:
A really small burial chamber, and the ceiling is so low you almost
hit your head. In the middle of the room, a tiny transparent coffin has
been placed. Within it, you see a small female body. You can't be sure,
but it seems to be a young gnomish girl. On the glass, some words have
been painted, 'Nioshi, avoided the dark with her tricks and quick
ways'. To the west the crossing can be seen.

Rooms.Name: A Passage in the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
A dark and musty catacomb moving from the north to the south,
binding together the tombs of the fallen. You can see a holy symbol
standing in the crossway both to the north and to the south of here.

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Worsh'ach, the Battlemage
Rooms.Description:
The very grim looking burial chamber of Worsh'ach, the Battlemage.
According to a small sign above his coffin, he repelled every single
flow of dark magic that was hurled against the forces of good. But 
finally, a poisoned arrow got through and killed him. To the east,
a crossing can be found.

Rooms.Name: A crossing in the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
A large and pretty dark room, with exits in all directions. A large
holy symbol has been placed in the middle of the crossing, glowing with
a faint light. Inscribed on the symbol are the words 'May the Light
shelter those who gave their lives for us'.

Exits.Description: The Tomb of Worsh'ach, the Battlemage

Rooms.Name: The Tomb of Ungir Brimstone
Rooms.Description:
Upon entering this chamber, you are struck by the magnificent walls.
Carvings everywhere, extremely beautiful..almost alive. A heavily
decorated coffin has been placed along the northern wall. A flowing
scripts marks the words 'Ungir Brimstone, Master of the blades. He
forged the light and combined it with steel'. To the west lies the exit
out of this chamber.

Rooms.Name: A Ruined Tomb
Rooms.Description:
Chaos fills this room. You see the remains of the tomb spread out
all over the room. Parts lie everywhere, but...who would have done such
a thing? You dig some after the nameplate, and find it well concealed
beneath the rubble. But when you try to read the name, you get a shock.
On the plate a name has been carved in a rigid script, 'Lord Gaheen,
our latest recruit...' then it becomes to hard to read. A long hallway
can be seen stretch out to the north.

Rooms.Name: A Ruined Hallway
Rooms.Description:
Everything in here is in a shambles. Tapestries have been torn to
pieces. Chairs and tables have been destroyed. Pieces litter the
floor. To the north a pair of huge doors can be seen. They look like
they've been through some heavy beating, since one of the doors is
hanging from one of it's hinges. To the south a hall is leading into a
large chamber.

Rooms.Name: Chamber of the Winds
Rooms.Description:
Here is a huge chamber, with a heavy wind somehow caught inside it.
From time to time, you almost get swept off your feet by the strong 
wind chasing through this chamber. Above you is a large trapdoor, and
a small ladder leads up to it. Then something glimmering catches your
eye. In the faint light from the torches that line the walls, you see
thousands of gems, embedded in the walls.

Exits.Description: The Tomb of Den'Drelich, the Windrider

Rooms.Name: A moldy ladder
Rooms.Description:
Standing on a rickety and very moldy ladder, you gaze down into the
pitch black darkness below you. You wonder quietly to yourself what
possibly could be down there. No sounds, no movement at all. Then you
feel a slight breeze caressing your cheek. Maybe there's something down
there after all.

Rooms.Name: Cavern entrance
Rooms.Description:
A small chamber, if it possibly could be called that, with a small
tunnel leading into the darkness to the east. You look up and wonder
if you should head back up the ladder, or walk into the black to the
east. It's cold down here and as you feel a small breeze touching your
skin, shivers run down your back.

Rooms.Name: Rocky tunnel
Rooms.Description:
A small tunnel, with very rocky walls. You have to dodge, crawl and
God knows what to get past some passages. To the west a faint light can
be seen, illuminating what seems to be a ladder. To the south, the tunnel
goes on.

Rooms.Name: Rocky tunnel
Rooms.Description:
A small tunnel, with very rocky walls. You have to dodge, crawl and
God knows what to get past some passages. To the north a small tunnel
goes on and to the south, sharp looking rocks form a dangerous looking
passage through the dark.

Rooms.Name: Rocky tunnel
Rooms.Description:
A small tunnel, with very rocky walls. You have to dodge, crawl and
God knows what to get past some passages. Southwards, a small tunnel can
be seen through the dim light. North you see sharp looking rocks forming
a tunnel.

Rooms.Name: Rocky tunnel
Rooms.Description:
A small tunnel, with very rocky walls. You have to dodge, crawl and
God knows what to get past some passages. To the east you see a large
chamber bathing in an eerie light. To the north it is pitch black, but
you know the rocky tunnel is there. Hoping, it will lead out.

Rooms.Name: Eerie cave
Rooms.Description:
A large cave, illuminated in a faintly ghastly glow. Looking up,
you see small holes leading up to the surface. Letting a little light in
to the cave. Watching the walls, you notice they are covered with some
strange looking moss that almost seems to absorb the little light there
is. To the west, a dark tunnel goes on. And to the south, you see a
tunnel heading into the mist. By one of the walls, you see a large crack
leading downwards into the unknown darkness.

Rooms.Name: Foggy deadend
Rooms.Description:
Entering this cave, you come to what seems to be a deadend. Wandering
around in the heavy mist that clouds this chamber, you come to the
conclusion, there's nothing here. But, strangely as it seems, you still
feel a slight breeze coming from someplace..someplace beyond the mist to
the south. To the north of you, there's a huge cavern filled with a
ghastly pale light.

Rooms.Name: The other side
Rooms.Description:
Strange as it seems, but a large wall of trees surround you. You look
around you, trying to find a way out. A small, almost tiny breach in the
wooden wall can be seen to the south. You wonder amusedly to yourself,
where you are and what happened to the caves you entered through.

Rooms.Name: The tree line
Rooms.Description:
Following the thin path surrounded by the trees, you finally come to
what seems to be an end to the path. Far ahead of you to the south, you
see light as the trees open up to a world unknown. To the south, the path
goes on into the woods.

Rooms.Name: Bottomless hole
Rooms.Description:
Flailing blindly with your arms, you pummel rapidly downwards through
the dark. A scream leaves your lips as terror overwhelms you. And you
fall forever and ever. And you never stop screaming..never..

Exits.Description: The edge of the cliff from which you jumped, willingly.

Mobs.Name: tomb guardian warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: A tall warrior stands here, proudly guarding the fallen.
Mobs.Description:
A tall warrior, clad in a finely woven chainmail shirt. As you look
upon the guardian, you feel how feelings of pride fill him. Proud to
guard the tombs of the fallen heroes. The ones who turned the events
of the battle into their favor.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote raises his head and stares straight ahead.;
%20 emote raises his fist and says 'Honor the Fallen ones.'

Mobs.Name: deathknight knight
Mobs.LongDescription: A ragged old knight wanders around here.
Mobs.Description:
A ancient knight in very torn clothes. You can barely make out the
sign of his family. A grim looking raven over a burning field. Then all
of a sudden he turns to face you. You get quite a shock as the hollow
eyes of the man looks you over.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 groan;
%30 moan

Mobs.Name: deathknight knight
Mobs.LongDescription: A bony knight is here, swaying in the wind.
Mobs.Description:
This very thin character is having obvious problems standing straight
in the strong wind. You wonder how long before it topples over. Then
all of a sudden, a strong gust of air blows in from the north, and the
knight falls to the ground. You reach out to give a hand, but as a
skeletal hand reaches out to grab it, you pull back in sheer fear.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote sways unsteadily in the wind.;
%5 emote catches the wind and crashes with a loud KAKAKABOOM!

Mobs.Name: deathknight knight wyneh
Mobs.LongDescription: A very thin and fragile looking knight wobbles around on unsteady legs.
Mobs.Description:
A extremely thin looking knight stands in front of you. Torn clothes
and ruined armor is what he is wearing. He, since you recognize his 
herald as Sir Wyneh's. A black rose on a snowcovered field. But, he
died a long time ago. Songs have been sung about his heroic death.
Then he removes his helmet, revealing a skeletal head with empty eye
sockets staring back at you, filling you with fear.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote removes his helmet and glares icily at you.;
%30 emote stares coldly at you, leaving you shivering with fear.

Mobs.Name: deathknight knight lord gaheen
Mobs.LongDescription: A tall knight, exudes power and ancient evil.
Mobs.Description:
A tall broadshouldered knight all dressed up in well kept armor. He 
looks you over carefully and fear takes hold of you, as the eerie
hollow eyes of the deathknight fall upon you. Lord Gaheen, a legendary
warrior, who fought for days in the front line, and fell beneath foul
necromancer magic. Now, he walks the earth again, 'thanks' to the same
magic that killed him.

Mobs.Name: necromancer character
Mobs.LongDescription: A black clad character is chanting wicked hymns to awaken the dead.
Mobs.Description:
A night black cloak covers this character. You can't see anything
beneath the cloak, except for a pair of eyes that seem to glow with a
fierce red color from time to time.

Mobs.Name: necromancer character man lord
Mobs.LongDescription: A grim looking man, dressed in black cloaks, grins wickedly at you.
Mobs.Description:
A grim looking man dressed in black cloaks, covered with golden runes.
As he sees you, he looks amused. Probably thinking you are pathetic.
Then all of a sudden he stands up, stretches his arms straight up
towards the sky, and shouts some guttural words. Lightning strikes his
fists, and he begins laughing. You start looking for a way out...

Mobs.Name: graverobber thief
Mobs.LongDescription: A thin crooked thief is sneaking around here, digging for the dead.
Mobs.Description:
A thin looking character, with a very crooked back. You wonder, if the
back is a result of carrying lots of corpses and coffins. Where ever
something glimmers, the thief is as well. Checking for valuables.
Digging here and there, trying to find a corpse...a treasure.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote begins digging for treasure.;
%30 steal gold mourner

Mobs.Name: graverobber thief looter
Mobs.LongDescription: A small thief stalks the area, looting the dead.
Mobs.Description:
A small thief with a thick hooded cloak covering its face. Where ever
something glimmers, this thief will be checking for valuables. Looting
the dead, stealing their treasures, thinking 'They are dead, so they
won't need it.'
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote loots a corpse, while giggling happily.;
%30 steal gold mourner

Mobs.Name: vampire man
Mobs.LongDescription: A tall man stands here, gazing towards the sky.
Mobs.Description:
A tall man with a clean shaved head, all dressed up in black flowing
robes. A peace fills you, but at the same time fear fills you. He
raises his head, looks you over and smiles. You try to turn and run,
but fear paralyzes you. In the faint moonlight, his fangs glimmer and
you feel a terrible cold seep into you.

Mobs.Name: beast
Mobs.LongDescription: A large beast is preying on victims here.
Mobs.Description:
A large beast, best described as a hybrid of a bear and a cobra. A very
long body that trails behind the huge 'upper' body. Two large muscular
arms, covered with fur. And claws, lots of long lethal looking claws.
Not to mention the fangs...

Mobs.Name: priestess
Mobs.LongDescription: A priestess wanders around here, sanctifying the area.
Mobs.Description:
A white clad character. A priestess judging by the holy symbols painted
on the clothes. Wandering around, giving blessings and sanctifying the 
battlefield.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote blesses you.;
%30 say May The Creator protect the fallen.

Mobs.Name: monk
Mobs.LongDescription: A brownrobed monk watches the field, wondering 'Why?'.
Mobs.Description:
A monk with thick brown woolen robes. Hands are up in the sleeves and
he moves slowly while reciting holy scripts and incantations. But
still, you admire this man of peace, who can remain so calm in such a
wicked place.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 say You are forgiven, my friend.;
%30 say Walk in peace, my friend.

Mobs.Name: cleric woman
Mobs.LongDescription: A woman stands in front of you, smiling warmly at you.
Mobs.Description:
This is one of the clerics who attend the blessings, keep up the wards
that keep evil away from this battlefield. She is wearing grey-white 
robes, and a small holy symbol is hanging around her neck. A soft glow
seems to shroud her.

Mobs.Name: paladin warrior priest
Mobs.LongDescription: A shining warrior priest watches you intently.
Mobs.Description:
A paladin! One of the warrior priests. One, dedicated to destroy evil,
to live by and uphold the laws. Master in fighting, adept in magic.
Seeker and destroyer of evil.

Mobs.Name: knight guardian
Mobs.LongDescription: A grim looking knight is on guard here.
Mobs.Description:
A knight with highly polished armor is here, looking grim and proud at
the same time. This is a guardian of the shrines. A guardian of the
altars where visitors may pray. Nothing but death could stop him from
performing his duty.

Mobs.Name: bard man
Mobs.LongDescription: A thin but very handsome man is here, reciting poems.
Mobs.Description:
A red embroidered cape is wrapped around the handsome young man before
you. A small lute can be seen strapped across his back. A bard you
think. A bard, who has come here to write stories for the world.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote recites some poetry.;
%30 emote sings a soft song for the fallen.

Mobs.Name: priest highpriest
Mobs.LongDescription: Blessed by the gods themselves, The High Priest protects the fallen.
Mobs.Description:
A feeling of purification washes over you as you look upon this man.
A soft blue glow can be seen around him, this old man with the warm and
very comforting smile. He is the high priest, the one who blesses and
sanctifies all the tombs every day.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 smile;
%30 emote looks at you, and smiles warmly.

Mobs.Name: mourner man
Mobs.LongDescription: A man is kneeling here, crying in his hands.
Mobs.Description:
A mid age man, who is full of sadness and pain. Crying, letting his
tears fall on the ground. Soothing his pain. Trying to forget AND
remember the lost one.

Mobs.Name: mourner woman
Mobs.LongDescription: Clutching her fists, the woman screams in pain and sorrow.
Mobs.Description:
A old woman, torn apart by grief and sorrow of the one she lost here.
A close family member perhaps. At least, someone who was very close to
her. Tears roll down her cheeks and only time will ease the pain.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 cry;
%30 emote shouts out her pain and sorrow.

Mobs.Name: zombie man dead
Mobs.LongDescription: A very decayed man, shambles around here.
Mobs.Description:
It's a small miracle this...'thing' actually lives. At least, when you
consider how decayed it really is. Bones can be seen sticking out
everywhere and worms are crawling all over it.

Mobs.Name: zombie woman dead
Mobs.LongDescription: A woman is rotting right before your eyes.
Mobs.Description:
It's a small miracle this...'thing' actually lives. At least, when you
consider how decayed it really is. Bones can be seen sticking out
everywhere and worms are crawling all over it.

Mobs.Name: dracolich undead dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: A huge undead dragon is resting here.
Mobs.Description:
Not a single bit of flesh can be seen on the huge skeletal body of the
long dead dragon - The Dracolich. A being created by powerful magic,
to hold and wield powerful magic.

Mobs.Name: king man el'egainon
Mobs.LongDescription: A man wearing a fancy coat, and a nice looking crown is praying here.
Mobs.Description:
King El'Egainon, Ruler of a far away kingdom. He lost his only child
in the battle. And at once, you wonder, how old are they?
The battlefield is ancient, what does that make them? He is wearing a
very nice looking crown and coat, cleary stating him as a rich and 
important man.

Mobs.Name: tomb guardian warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: A tall warrior stands here, proudly guarding the fallen.
Mobs.Description:
A tall warrior, clad in a finely woven chainmail shirt. As you look
upon the guardian, you feel how feelings of pride fill him. Proud to
guard the tombs of the fallen heroes. The ones who turned the events
of the battle into their favor.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote raises his head and stares straight ahead.;
%20 emote raises his fist and says 'Honor the Fallen ones.'

Mobs.Name: tomb guardian warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: A tall warrior stands here, proudly guarding the fallen.
Mobs.Description:
A tall warrior, clad in a finely woven chainmail shirt. As you look
upon the guardian, you feel how feelings of pride fill him. Proud to

Objects.Name: wardancer sword blade
Objects.Description: A beautiful short sword is lying on the ground, humming softly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very beautiful blade, attached to a heavily decorated hilt. A short
sword meant for the wardancer. Those who feel the rhytm of the battle
pounding in their heart. For those who dance into battle, those who 
dance the blades.

Objects.Name: blessed touch vial
Objects.Description: A small vial, glowing with a soft white light.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small vial, made of what seems to be glass. But you can't be sure,
since the whole vial is glowing with a soft white glow, making it hard
to focus upon. Everything feels so unreal about it.

Objects.Name: hymns book vengeance
Objects.Description: A large book with words written in a fine flowing white script.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large grey leatherbound book, with words telling of revenge, written
with a fine delicate white script.

Objects.Name: essence life mist potion
Objects.Description: A tiny potion, shrouded with a greyish mist.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very small black flask, with a greyish mist swirling around it.
On the flask, a small label can be seen, 'Essence of life'.

Objects.Name: banner winds wind
Objects.Description: A large banner is standing here, catching the winds.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large banner made of what seems to be silk, or something similar at
least. As the banner catches the wind, it expands, becoming a huge twin
of its true self.

Objects.Name: halberd battlerager
Objects.Description: A halberd covered with tiny silvery runes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A long halberd covered with small runes, small silvery runes. The runes
tell of a magnificent warrior, and that this weapon was created for
him to wield in battle. A battlerager's weapon.

Objects.Name: chainmail holy
Objects.Description: A chainmail, blessed with holy incantations.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A blue chainmail, with streaks of grey embedded in it. Strange you
think, since it is a chainmail after all. But then, it is glowing as
well, so why not? Stories tell of, a soul forged with the steel in this
chainmail, thus making it very special.

Objects.Name: crown roses
Objects.Description: A crown of fresh red roses.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A tiny crown, encircled with sweet smelling red roses. You wonder if
these roses ever die. It's a truly beautiful crown, fit for the
greatest of beauties.

Objects.Name: bone piece fragment
Objects.Description: A skeletal fragment of a dracolich.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bone fragment of a long dead beast, a dracolich. You feel powerful
magic flow through this piece of bone. Pulsating with energy, as if it
was alive. Magic powers throbbing within like a beating heart.

Objects.Name: bone piece fragment
Objects.Description: A skeletal fragment of a dracolich.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bone fragment of a long dead beast, a dracolich. You feel powerful
magic flow through this piece of bone. Pulsating with energy, as if it
was alive. Magic powers throbbing within like a beating heart.

Objects.Name: bone piece fragment
Objects.Description: A skeletal fragment of a dracolich.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bone fragment of a long dead beast, a dracolich. You feel powerful
magic flow through this piece of bone. Pulsating with energy, as if it
was alive. Magic powers throbbing within like a beating heart.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bone fragment of a long dead beast, a dracolich. You feel powerful
magic flow through this piece of bone. Pulsating with energy, as if it
was alive. Magic powers throbbing within like a beating heart.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bone fragment of a long dead beast, a dracolich. You feel powerful

Objects.Name: bone piece fragment
Objects.Description: A skeletal fragment of a dracolich.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bone fragment of a long dead beast, a dracolich. You feel powerful
magic flow through this piece of bone. Pulsating with energy, as if it
was alive. Magic powers throbbing within like a beating heart.

Objects.Name: phantom mirror reflection
Objects.Description: The reflection of a phantom is here, caught in a mirror.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large mirror, or a shield that is highly polished. Either way,
there's a reflection of someone, or something, caught within it.
Moving, twisting, trying to break the spell that captured it within
the mirror.

Objects.Name: blade hilt light
Objects.Description: A fine looking hilt, shaped out of whitegold metal.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very nice looking hilt, carved out of some sort of whitegold metal.
This hilt is a true masterpiece. Then, all of a sudden as you grip the
hilt, a long flaming blade shoots out from it. Blessed fire to light up
the darkness.

Objects.Name: heart neckchain brave
Objects.Description: A gilded neckchain with a small heart attached to it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A thin gilded neckchain with a small red heart hanging from it.
The heart seems to be made of metal, but you fail to recognize it.
The heart of the brave, given to those showing exceptional courage in
their darkest hour.

Objects.Name: jewelled dagger
Objects.Description: Small precious gems adorn the half sheated dagger in front of you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Small, finely cut gems adorn this dagger. Examining the gems, you come
to the conclusion it must be worth a lot. The blade is slighty curved,
not to mention, very sharp.

Objects.Name: moonshard staff moon
Objects.Description: A long staff, topped with something resembling a waning moon.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A long wooden staff, seemingly made out of oak, with a strange figure
topping it. It resembles a waning moon, glowing in the darkness of the
night. Upon grabbing the staff, you immediately feel tremendous power
rushing within it. Feeling the shard of the moon, channeling the energy
through you.

Objects.Name: hammer illuminator
Objects.Description: A large and heavy hammer is illuminating the area.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large and heavy hammer made of solid white stone. The stone itself,
seems to be created with powerful magic, since it is glowing and
'pulling' the light. Making the light more condense around the stone.
Stories tell of Ungir Brimstone, who forged the light with steel by
using this hammer.

Objects.Name: signet ring
Objects.ShortDescription: Signet ring of the Black Altar
Objects.Description: A plain black metal ring.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small plain looking ring, made of some kind of black metal. Upon
examining it more closely, you notice some tiny runes, telling of the
unholy procedure of creating the powerful deathknight this ring was
given to.

Objects.Name: deceiver helm
Objects.Description: Fooling your senses, this helm blurs out of sight.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A blur of colors fool your senses and you shake your head in anger and
frustration. Trying to gather your thoughts, trying to focus. This helm
is some piece of work. Heavy magic has been used here, used to make
this helm, and propably the wearer as well, more difficult to notice.

Objects.Name: breastplate atrocities black
Objects.Description: Large spikes are sticking out from this pitch black breastplate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pitch black breastplate, made of thick steel. Large spikes can be
seen sticking out from it, only to inflict more damage in close combat,
but at the same time, risking the health of the wearer.

Objects.Name: spiked armplates plates
Objects.Description: Some armplates with huge spikes protruding from them.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of armplates made of thick steel, with huge spikes attached to
them. You can imagine the damage those spikes could inflict if used
the right way.

Objects.Name: black greaves
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of night black steel greaves
Objects.Description: A pair of greaves, dark as the night.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of greaves, made of pitch black metal. A formidable piece of
armor, which also, without any doubt, will inflict large amounts 
of damage if used properly.

Objects.Name: footplates nightwanderer
Objects.Description: Some footplates meant for those who follow the darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of footplates made of thick black steel. Created to give the
best protection while inflicting extreme damage.

Objects.Name: dark gauntlets
Objects.Description: A pair of gauntlets made of fine black metal.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of dark gauntlets, made of very fine metal. Some golden runes
can be seen carved into them, but they are so worn down so you fail to
decipher them.

Objects.Name: reaper night sword
Objects.Description: A thin black shadowy sword, crying out for more bloodshed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very thin looking sword, yearning for you to take it out into battle
against goodness. A shadow of death and destruction.

Objects.Name: gauntlets necromancy
Objects.Description: A pair of glowing gauntlets, draining the area of all energy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of metallic looking gauntlets, glowing with a fierce red light.
As you try them on, you immediately feel how strength and energy starts
flowing into you, making you stronger than ever.

Objects.Name: sickle longshafted
Objects.Description: A longshafted sickle with an ancient runecovered blade.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A long pole with a sickle attached to one end of it. The blade appears
to be old, very old, and is covered with runes. The runes tell of
energies to be drained and controlled, death and destruction, torture
and pain.

Objects.Name: torn cape fragment shadow
Objects.Description: A fragment of a shadow, expanding and disappearing in the wind.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pitch black cape, or more exactly, the remains of a pitch black cape.
Large pieces are missing, but still, it sends shivers down your back as
you feel cold magic flow within. Then all of a sudden, the wind catches
it, and the cape expands into huge proportions, at the same time fading
more and more into the shadowy nightsky.

Objects.Name: tonfa wooden stick handle
Objects.Description: A short but thick wooden stick with a handle attached to it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A short wooden stick, although very thick piece of wood, with a small
handle attached to it. In the right hands, this will be a formidable
weapon. An extension of the arm and the fist, at the same time, giving
protection as well.

Objects.Name: cape red cloth
Objects.Description: A pile of red embroidered cloth.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very fine piece of cloth, or more exactly, a very nice looking cape.
Very soft, the touch of velvet. Warm and nice. The cape is heavily
embroidered, with thick golden strands swirling around in intricate
patterns.

Objects.Name: staff benedictions
Objects.Description: A holy staff, glowing with peace and calm, soothing your senses.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A long staff covered with intricate carvings and holy symbols. It's
topped with a golden holy symbol that is giving off a faint glow. This
staff is holy, very holy. The bane of darkness, only usable by those
with the purest of hearts.

Objects.Name: robe cloth white
Objects.Description: A robe made of purest and whitest cloth.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very beautiful robe, made of pure white cloth. It's so white and
clean, it seems to glow. A robe meant for the one who has a heart of
absolute goodness.

Objects.Name: egainon crown compassion
Objects.Description: A beautiful crown made of gold and silver.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very beautiful crown, seemingly made out of gold and silver. Black
pearls surround it, and a large red gem has been placed at the front.
Still, sadness fills your heart as you look upon the crown. This crown
was meant for King El'Egainon's daughter, but now he carries it always
with him to remind himself of her fate.
